title: Translations update from Hosted Weblate
body:
Translations update from [Hosted Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org) for [Pop OS/COSMIC Comp](https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/pop-os/cosmic-comp/).



Current translation status:
